name: Pi Pocket
short_desc: Durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for the Pi coding agent
author: TannerMidd
description: Pi Pocket runs the Pi coding agent on Pi Durable behind a web app (PWA): sessions survive server restarts, scheduled messages, plan mode, forks, worktrees, push notifications, invites with roles and spend limits. Models come from Pi's own config (~/.pi/agent/models.json in the data volume). Anyone who can steer a session gets a shell in this container: keep it on the LAN.

form_fields.label: Extra apt packages
form_fields.hint: Installed at every container start, space separated. Add chromium for the built-in browser.
form_fields.default: jq rsync ripgrep sqlite3 dnsutils iputils-ping
